claim: The walkthrough holds 56 PNG screenshots and 64 page-text captures plus Instinct's notes and cross-vendor report; all 64 text captures were read for this analysis. Nine PNGs numbered 20-28 (named logs, metrics, api-keys, members, billing, org-settings, members, api-keys, org-settings) all show the 'Welcome to Vapi' onboarding wall, not the page their file name says.

The text captures with the same numbers show the real page under the wall: 20=Logs, 21=Metrics, 24=Billing, 26=Members, 28=Org settings. 22-api-keys.txt is actually the Integrations page (/settings/integrations); 23-members.txt, 25-org-settings.txt and 27-api-keys.txt are 404 pages reached by guessed URLs (/members, /org-settings, /settings/api-keys). Real routes: /settings/members, /settings/organization, /settings/billing, /settings/integrations, /settings/organizations, /settings/profile, /org/api-keys, /reporting/boards, /structured-outputs, /metrics, /logs, /library/voice, /files, /issues, /monitors, /notifiers, /simulations/suites, /campaigns/new.

The sidebar groups are VAPI LABS (Composer); BUILD (Assistants, Squads, Tools, Phone Numbers, Campaigns, Resources[expandable: Voice library, Files seen]); TEST (Evals, Simulations[expandable; Suites page seen]); OBSERVE (Logs, Boards, Structured Outputs, Monitoring[Issues, Monitors, Notifiers], Metrics); INTEGRATIONS (API Keys, Integrations); MANAGE (Members, Organizations, Billing & Payment, Org Settings, Profile). Footer shows 'No package', '5 Credits' and a persistent 'Buy credits' button. Org switcher and Cmd+K search sit at the top.

Maturity is badged in the nav and in-page: Campaigns = Beta (orange), Monitoring and Notifiers = Alpha (purple), 'Try GPT Live' = Experimental, Eleven v3 voice = Experimental, Scribe v2 = Beta. Composer carries no badge (only an info icon beside VAPI LABS). Enterprise gating is a crown card (Recording Consent Plan) and add-on text (HIPAA, ZDR).

First run: a 'Welcome to Vapi' page with one required field (full name) and two optional questions (how you found Vapi: 8 tiles; business goal: Personal / Small business / Enterprise), a 'Start Building' button below the fold, no step count. Per Instinct it re-appeared on every load until completed, and after completion lands on a full-screen /agent-builder with no sidebar and a 'Skip to dashboard' button.

Login is password plus an emailed 6-digit code; sessions died twice and needed fresh codes; pages loaded in 10-15 s; direct URL loads often rendered blank while in-app sidebar clicks were reliable. Reported by Instinct in notes (no screenshot of the login screens).

The agent-builder landing offers two entry paths on one screen: three type cards (Inbound 'Answer calls, greet customers, take messages'; Outbound 'Sales calls, follow-ups, appointment reminders'; Support 'Troubleshoot issues, route to specialists, resolve tickets') or a free-text box with placeholder 'Build an appointment booking agent'. What the generated agent looks like was not captured.

A new org needs zero builder steps to reach a working agent in the dashboard because a template assistant 'Riley' (appointment scheduler for a fictional clinic, GPT-4.1, Vapi voice Elliot v2) already exists at v1; the org was created 2026-10-20 21:57 and Riley is listed with the account phase's earlier finding that a new org is seeded with Riley.

The Create Assistant split button opens four starter templates: Customer Support ('Resolves issues and answer customer questions'), Lead Qualification ('Qualifies leads and route to sales'), Appointment Scheduler ('Manage customer appointments'), Info Collector ('Collects customer information'). No blank-assistant item appears in the menu. Not clicked (clicking may create an assistant).

The assistant page has a header (name, version pill V1, 'Traffic' link, truncated id, test-call split button, save/publish button, kebab), five tabs (Assistant, Logs, Tools, Analysis, Advanced), a Cost/Latency summary with stacked bars, four Model Presets plus 'Try GPT Live', three pipeline cards (Transcriber, Model, Voice) each opening a right-hand settings panel, then a system-prompt editor (Visual / Code / Normal text modes, search, Generate, '{{' variable insert, token counter), a First message card and a Files card.

The default assistant shows a headline of ~$0.09/min and ~1,530 ms, with per-component cards: Transcriber Soniox STT RT v5 (410 ms, $0.004/min, 1.8% WER); Model GPT-4.1 (690 ms, $0.02/min, Intelligence 20); Voice Vapi Voices v2 'Elliot' (430 ms, $0.02/min, Humanness 92). These are vendor-displayed, not measured by us.

The ~1,530 ms latency headline is exactly the sum of the three component latencies (410 + 690 + 430). It therefore excludes the End-of-Turn Wait (1.5 s on this assistant), telephony transport and the handset side. The latency bar segments match this: orange about 27% = 410/1530.

The ~$0.09/min cost headline is about $0.05 hosting plus $0.004 + $0.02 + $0.02 components = $0.094. The cost bar's teal segment is about 53% of the bar (0.05/0.094), the other three about 4%, 21%, 21%, matching transcriber, model, voice. Telephony transport is not in the headline (the pricing page says transport is charged by the provider).

Every picker row shows latency, price per minute and one quality score (WER for transcribers, Intelligence for models, Humanness for voices) inline, with a search box, a sort icon and a 'Providers: All' filter. Intelligence and Humanness are bare integers with no scale or definition on screen; WER is not labelled with a language.

Catalogue sizes in the open dropdowns (counted from the text captures): about 92 LLM rows (about 14 are repeated or deprecated rows across provider groups), 45 voice-model rows, 40 transcriber rows, a 57-language transcriber picker plus 'Automatic', 15 tool types, 52 integration tiles, and 12 stock voices in the library grid.

Displayed figures at the edges: LLMs from GPT-5.6 Luna $0.010/min 770 ms / 27 Intelligence to GPT-5.6 Sol $0.029 / 1,060 ms / 42; Claude Sonnet 5 2,000 ms $0.060 with no score; GPT Realtime 2 $0.645/min; voices from Inworld TTS 1.5 Mini $0.003/min to Eleven v3 (Experimental) $0.036 / 850 ms / 95 Humanness (Vapi Voices v2 is 92); transcribers from Ink Whisper $0.003/min to Azure $0.034/min, with Universal 3.6 Pro at 1.0% WER and the default STT RT v5 at 1.8%.

Picker metrics are incomplete and uneven: Sonic 3.6 shows price only, Sonic 3.5 (dated) shows latency and price but no Humanness, Sonic shows '0 Humanness', Gemini and GPT-Transcribe rows show no WER, many Claude/Gemini/Grok rows show no Intelligence, and prices appear at different precision ($0.004 vs $0.01). Newer versions therefore cannot be compared with older ones in the UI.

About 30 LLM rows show exactly $0.010/min (for example GPT-5 Nano, Gemini 2.5 Flash, OpenRouter, Llama 3.1 8B) while others show $0.002; the repeated $0.010 looks like a floor or placeholder rather than a per-model cost, so the cost column is not informative at the cheap end. Not verified against any invoice.

Vendor-displayed LLM latencies sit at or below our India first-token medians: gpt-oss 500 ms displayed vs 535 ms (n=5) measured, GPT-4.1 Mini 600 vs 567 (n=5), GPT-5.4 Mini 720 vs 960, Gemini 3.8 Flash 1,500 vs 1,991, GPT-4.1 690 vs 1,765 (n=6), GPT-6 Luna 940 vs 1,438 (via OpenRouter). Two of six pairs agree within about 70 ms and four are 240-1,075 ms higher from India; the displayed numbers are probably from a US vantage and the method behind them is not stated. Pairs are not matched on route.

Trade-offs are surfaced three ways: four one-click presets (Balanced active, High Intelligence, Ultra Fast, Cost Saver), per-component latency/cost/quality on cards, and the stacked bars. What each preset changes is not shown. 'Try GPT Live' (a speech-to-speech option) is offset and badged Experimental.

The Soniox language multi-select (search, Select All, Automatic, English checked) lists 57 languages. Indian: Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Urdu, plus Nepali. Bengali, Telugu, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia and Assamese are not in this picker, although the API spec lists them for Soniox (12 Indic codes per prior research).

No Indian speech vendor appears in any picker or in the Integrations catalogue (voice 12, model 15, transcriber 7 tiles): no Sarvam, no AI4Bharat/Bhashini/Gnani. Indic access is through global vendors (Soniox, Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, Cartesia and others).

Instinct's notes report that the Cartesia voice list contains Indic-named voices (a stray click set 'Aadhya soother' on Sonic 3.5). No screenshot of the voice list exists, so the Indic voice count per provider is unknown.

The Voice library (Provider: Vapi, Gender, Accent, 'All voices' filters) shows 12 Vapi voices, all V2, with name, gender and accent chips only (no language, price or latency). Only two are Indian-accented and both are labelled 'INDIAN AMERICAN' (Sagar, Naina); the rest are American, one Canadian. Prior API research counted 22 stock voices including a third Indian-American voice (Rohan), so this grid is either paginated or filtered.

Language defaults are English-first and internally unclear: transcriber language is a single 'English' chip while the helper text reads 'Automatic detects the spoken language from the audio' and the Automatic option is unchecked; the voice 'Primary language' is Automatic on an American-tagged voice; voice speed shows about 1.1 (last digit clipped); Background Sound is Default (office on phone calls, off on web calls).

Transcriber panel defaults: Intelligent Turn-Taking is OFF ('Off: the assistant waits a fixed silence delay instead'); End-of-Turn Wait is 1.5 s on a 0-3 s slider with a typed field; Keywords empty; Background Denoising toggle appears OFF (partly clipped).

A 1.5 s fixed end-of-turn wait is the same size as Bolna's inferred default reply floor (500 ms endpointing plus a 900 ms hold, about 1.4 s) and equals the API's onNoPunctuation default of 1.5 s, but the dashboard does not say which backend setting the slider writes and the 1,530 ms headline does not include it. Whether it adds to the 0.4 s start-speaking wait is unknown without a call.

The Advanced tab (full text captured) exposes Start Speaking Plan (Wait Seconds 0-5; Smart Endpointing with options Off and LiveKit, 'LiveKit is only available in English'; On Punctuation / On No Punctuation / On Number seconds, each 0-3) and Stop Speaking Plan (Number of Words 0-10; Voice Seconds 0-0.5; Back Off Seconds 0-10). The current slider values were not captured. No acknowledgement or interruption phrase lists, and no custom endpointing model, appear in the dashboard text.

Other call-control knobs on the Advanced tab: Voicemail Detection Provider (shown Off; help text names Vapi, Google, OpenAI and Twilio AMD); Silence Timeout 5-3600 s; Maximum Duration 10-43,200 s; Keypad Input (enable, timeout 0-10 s, delimiter # or *); End Call Message; End Call Phrases (comma-separated substrings of the bot transcript); Idle Messages (max 1-10, timeout 5-60 s); Voicemail Message; Audio Recording Format WAV; Video Recording toggle; Client Messages (13 selected) and Server Messages (11 selected). Deprecated block: End Call Function, Dial Keypad, Forwarding Phone Number, Custom Functions.

The Create Tool menu has 15 items in three labelled groups plus one ungrouped item: PHONE CALL TOOLS (Transfer Call, Hang Up, Leave Voicemail, DTMF, Send Text, SIP Request), ASSISTANT TOOLS (Handoff, Query), INTEGRATIONS (API Request, MCP, Slack, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, GoHighLevel), then Function tool. Instinct's final report says 16 types; the capture lists 15. The API has 26 tool types, so the dashboard shows only part of them.

Choosing a tool type in the Create Tool menu immediately created and published a tool named 'transfer_call_tool' (success toast 'Your tool has been created successfully', status Published, version v1) with no pre-creation form; Instinct deleted it afterwards. The editor has Tool Settings (name, description 0/1000), Destinations (Add Destination: Phone Number or SIP) and a collapsed Messages section.

Attaching a tool to an assistant is a two-step path when no tools exist: 'Add tool' opens a search popover ('Search by name, type, or id') that shows 'No tools found.' with an '+ Add new tool' row. The assistant Tools tab describes API requests, scheduling, messaging, transfers and custom code.

Knowledge base in the dashboard is a Files page ('Files allow assistants to search information in your documents', Upload file, Docs link, empty), a 'Select Files' control on the assistant, and a Query tool type. No chunking, embedding, source-connector or retrieval settings appear in any capture.

Squads are an empty list with the explainer 'Organize multiple AI assistants to cooperate in a call, routing conversations to the right assistant based on conditions' and a New Squad button (twice) plus Composer. The squad editor was not opened. Campaigns can choose Assistant or Squad.

The Integrations page lists 52 tiles in 8 groups: Voice 12 (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, Azure Speech, Inworld, RimeAI, SmallestAI, Neuphonic, Hume, LMNT, MiniMax, PlayHT[Deprecated]), Model 15, Transcriber 7 (Deepgram, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, Azure Speech, Gladia, Speechmatics, Soniox), Tool 6 (Make, GoHighLevel, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel MCP), Phone 3 (SIP Trunk, Telnyx, Vonage), Cloud storage 7, Observability 1 (Langfuse), Server Configuration 1. No connected/not-connected status is shown; Twilio is absent here though the phone dialog imports Twilio.

Test and quality surfaces: a call split-button in every assistant header (test call), Composer 'Test: Talk to my agent in the dashboard', Evals ('Create evaluations ... running mock conversations and validating responses against your criteria'), Simulations Suites ('repeatable scenarios' for assistants or squads), Analysis tab (Structured Outputs with Add Field, Scorecard 'grade calls automatically', Attached Monitors), and Monitoring (Issues, Monitors, Notifiers). All are empty states; no test call, eval, simulation or monitor was created.

Monitoring (Alpha) is organised around Issues with Critical and Warning counts plus MTTR, Calls Impacted (1h default, 24h, 7d) and four categories (Infrastructure, Technical, Effectiveness, Compliance). The empty Monitors page promotes 'Enable default monitors for free'. Notifiers send alerts by email, Slack or webhook. The zero-issues state reads 'Great news!' without distinguishing 'no monitors configured'.

Logs has tabs Calls, Chat, Sessions, Webhooks, API; filters Time Range (default Last 7 days), Call ID, Assistants, Squads, Phone Numbers, Call Types, Customer Phone Number; columns Call ID, Assistant/Squad, Version, Squad version, Assistant Phone Number, Customer Phone Number, Type, Ended Reason, Start Time (GMT+5:30), Duration, Cost; Export All; 25 rows per page. Boards has a default 'Metrics Overview' board (Call Volume, Total Call Minutes, Concurrent Calls, Reason Call Ended, Unsuccessful Calls, Average Cost Breakdown per Minute) with Create Insight, date range, grouping, assistant filter and auto-refresh (Off). Metrics adds Cost Breakdown, Success Evaluation and Average Call Duration by Assistant.

The only call in the account is an outbound row with Ended Reason 'call.start.error get ass...', duration N/A and $0.00; Metrics counts it as 'Number of Calls 1' with 0.00 minutes. Instinct reports it as pre-existing; it is probably our own 2026-10-20 API probe (an empty POST /call that failed at start), which would mean a failed start still creates a log row and counts as a call. The ended reason is shown as an engineering code, truncated in the legend.

Phone Number Options has six tabs: Free Vapi Number (area code; 'Free US phone numbers, 0 of 1 used on this subscription'; US area codes only; 'Inbound only: for new accounts, Vapi numbers cannot make outbound calls'), Free Vapi SIP (SIP identifier giving sip:identifier@sip.vapi.ai, label, optional username and password), Import Twilio (number with country selector, Account SID, Auth Token, Label, SMS Enabled ON by default), Import Vonage (number, API Key, API Secret, Label), Import Telnyx (number, API Key, Label), BYO SIP Trunk Number (number, 'Allow non-E164' checkbox unchecked, SIP Trunk Credential select, Label).

The India path is absent in the dialogs: the country selector defaults to a US flag with +1 placeholders, free numbers are US-only and inbound-only, outbound requires importing your own number from Twilio, Vonage, Telnyx or a SIP trunk, there is no KYC or Indian carrier option inside Vapi, and no per-number price appears in the dashboard (phone pages, dialogs, billing). The BYO SIP form needs an existing SIP trunk credential and shows no 'create credential' link. The empty-state copy names only Twilio, vonage and a free number.

The New campaign wizard has three steps (Campaign details, Contacts, Schedule). Step 1 has campaign name (placeholder 'Campaign initiative'), Phone Number select (searchable; with no numbers it shows only '+ Create phone number'), a 'Best Practices: spam flagging' callout, Who makes the calls (Assistant or Squad, then a select), Max Concurrency slider at 4 / 4 (plan limit) and an optional collapsed 'Webhook settings'. Next stays disabled until a phone number is chosen, so steps 2 and 3 were never reached. Opening the wizard did not create anything.

Across all 64 text captures there is no consent, DND/NCPR, DLT, sender-ID, calling-window, retry, contact or opt-out field or screen, and no INR price. The only compliance-like items are the Recording Consent Plan (Enterprise), HIPAA and ZDR (billing gates), a Compliance monitor category, and the spam-flagging callout. This is an observed absence in the captured pages; campaign steps 2-3 and create forms for monitors, evals, suites and structured outputs were not seen.

Contacts step (CSV upload, number normalisation, duplicates, empty rows, opt-out) and Schedule step (window, time zone, recurrence, retries) of the campaign wizard are unknown from this walkthrough; prior research read the CSV code and API schema only.

Billing & payment shows Package None, Credit balance $5, Apply coupon, Monthly fees $0.00 on Nov 1 2026, Add payment method, tabs Utilization / Payments / Packages, a call-minutes chart (Daily/Weekly, 'October 1 to October 21', empty), and Consumption & capacity: Organizations 1/2, Vapi phone numbers 0/1, Concurrent call lines 4 max (shared with all organizations), Concurrent simulations 1 max, API limit 200 requests/min per org, Call history 14 days. Currency is USD only; 'Buy credits' is always visible in the sidebar.

The public pricing page (text only, no screenshot) shows: No Success Package = pre-paid $0.05/min Vapi hosting, $5 free credits, 2 orgs, 1 Vapi number, 4 concurrent calls, 14 days data retention, full model catalogue, Discord and email support without SLA; Core = 2 orgs, 5 numbers, 10 concurrent, 30 days, ZDR, 2-business-day response SLA; Pro = '10% of Vapi hosting fee, $999/mo minimum', 10 orgs, 10 numbers, 30 concurrent, 180 days, RBAC + ZDR, dedicated Slack, 99% uptime SLA; Premier = custom, 99.9% SLA, 1 h P0 response, SSO, dedicated SIP. Provider costs pass through 'with no markup'; HIPAA is an add-on; transport (telephony) is charged by the provider.

The '$82-$129/mo' block on the pricing page lists 'Concurrent calls 4, Organizations 2, Raw data retention 14 days', which matches the No-package tier on the billing page (4 / 2 / 14 days), not Core (10 / 2 / 30 days). It is probably the calculator's monthly estimate at an unseen minutes setting. Instinct's notes label it 'Core ~$82-129/mo'; that label is doubtful. The Core fee itself is not in the captures.

Org settings has Organization Name/Email/ID/Subscription ID, a Channel select (Daily or Weekly: 'controls which cluster your org's API requests will be routed to'; ours is Daily), Call Concurrency Limit ('update it on the Billing Page'), API Rate Limit ('contact support to increase'), HIPAA Enabled (add-on), Zero data retention, Auto Transcriber Fallback for New Assistants, org-level Server URL (timeout 1-300 s, Authorization credential, HTTP headers, static IPs in 167.150.224.0/23), Clear/Save and a type-the-name Delete Organization. No region or data-residency selector appears.

Zero data retention is described inconsistently: Org settings says 'ZDR is included in the Core and Pro packages' with an Upgrade package button; the assistant Advanced tab says 'The ZDR add-on is required to enable Zero Data Retention. Go to Billing'; Instinct's notes call ZDR a paid add-on. HIPAA is consistently an add-on.

Team: one member (team@vyakti.ai, name Vyakti Team, role Admin, last sign-in shown) with an Add Member button; the only role seen is Admin; RBAC is a Pro-tier feature on the pricing page. Organizations page: 'Total org capacity 1 of 2', Success package None, Add-ons 0 orgs $0/mo, sortable table (Name, Channel, Membership, contact email, Created on), New organization button. Profile: first/last name, read-only email, password change, Delete Account; no MFA or session setting was visible.

API keys page: Private API keys (two rows, one named 'Vp-Teardown', values masked [secret redacted] with reveal, copy, delete) and Public API keys (one row; restrictions Origins All domains, Assistants All, Transient Assistants Allowed; its delete icon is dimmed). Key rows show a name only: no created date, last-used or scope. The route is /org/api-keys; /settings/api-keys is a 404.

The Recording Consent Plan is shown in place as a crown-icon card ('Ask for consent at the start of the call without storing recordings, logs, or transcripts until the user consents. Available on Enterprise plans.') with no price, Upgrade or Contact button inside the card. HIPAA Compliance and ZDR rows link to Billing.

Contradiction with prior API reading: the billing page shows 'Concurrent simulations 1 max' (labelled 'Concurrent chat simulations per org') while the account phase read 2 concurrent simulations from GET /eval/simulation/concurrency. The two may count voice and chat separately; this was not reconciled.

Draft/publish is explicit in the dashboard: edits turn the header label from 'V1' to an orange 'Draft' and the save button into an orange publish split-button; a 'Traffic' link and version pill sit beside the name. This differs from the API behaviour recorded earlier (each PATCH publishes a version): the dashboard works through drafts.

Instinct reports that picking a voice in a dropdown persisted immediately as a server-side draft (Cartesia 'Aadhya soother'), and that after reverting and 'Discard Changes' the header still showed 'Draft'. Selecting in a dropdown therefore autosaves, and the Draft indicator can stay on after a discard. Reported in notes; the draft header itself is visible in the 52 and 80 screenshots.

Layout defects visible on nearly every screen: the two-line info banner's close X overlaps the word 'Migration'; the OBSERVE group is clipped behind the credits card at 720 px so Logs is half hidden; 'Create X' CTAs are duplicated (header and centre) on Squads, Campaigns, Evals, Files, Monitors; primary-button styling is inconsistent (outlined 'Create Tool' and 'Create Phone Number' vs solid green 'New Squad'); several panels clip content (Speed field digit, voice tag chips, tab strip needing an overflow chevron when a panel is open); chart x-axis tick labels overlap on Metrics.

Strong UX patterns seen: every picker row carries latency, cost and quality in one line; the cost and latency headline with a per-stage coloured bar and matching card dots; four trade-off presets; section cards with a one-line purpose each; empty states that explain the concept; gating shown in place; static-IP and server-URL settings at both org and assistant level; Cmd+K search; and a Composer entry in every page header.

Composer (VAPI LABS) is a chat pane with Threads (0), 'New thread', a greeting and four starter modes: Build 'Walk me through building an agent', Debug 'Diagnose recent call failures', Analyze 'Review call analytics for the week', Test 'Talk to my agent in the dashboard', plus an 'Ask for approval' control. A Composer button also sits in the header of most pages. It was not used; what it can do is unknown from this walkthrough.

There is no Contacts, Customers, CRM, Memory or Personalisation item anywhere in the nav, builder or settings; customers appear only as a filter and column on Logs and inside campaigns. A Recording consent concept exists only as an Enterprise gate. No self-learning or auto-improve control is visible (monitors, scorecards and simulations are the manual loop).

Unknown without live calls: the real reply gap on defaults and whether the 1.5 s wait adds to it; Hinglish language hold on 'Automatic'; whether English acknowledgement/interruption lists mis-fire on Hindi; Intelligent Turn-Taking and denoising effect; voicemail detection on Indian network announcements; DTMF and +91 transfer; real cost per connected minute with telephony; Composer's output on a Hinglish brief; Try GPT Live in Hindi.
